llm.justification: strat_drift decreased from 0.39 to ~0.15 with B-spline smoothing and dynamic reference, indicating reduced pressure-gradient error. Pnet_MW changes sign from negative (over-damped) to positive only for gamma=0.001, giving physically expected barotropic-to-baroclinic conversion. bt_M2_amp remains nearly constant (~0.083) across runs, confirming forcing consistency. uv_ratio increases with stronger viscosity (2.36→4.64), so it does not reliably track numerical error. spec_tail_frac stays near 0.66 despite very different damping, showing it is insensitive to the parameters tested. deep_dc_rms and all_dc_rms decrease with smoothing, but they can be artificially lowered by over-smoothing, so they are not trustworthy alone. The chosen configuration provides a reasonable compromise: moderate biharmonic viscosity (1e8 m^4/s), light B-spline smoothing (gamma=0.001), and dynamic reference enabled.
